detailed_results.name: Simple Count (English)
detailed_results.query: How many cases are registered in Bengaluru City?
detailed_results.generated_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) as CaseCount FROM CaseMaster CM JOIN Unit U ON CM.PoliceStationID = U.UnitID JOIN District D ON U.DistrictID = D.DistrictID WHERE D.DistrictName LIKE '%Bengaluru%'
detailed_results.ai_response: A total of 3 cases are registered in Bengaluru City.
